items.label: 200FT Extra-Long size
items.value: Most string lights on the market are only 50-120ft size,For large yards,pool sides,or long fences often require multiple strings to be connected,resulting in tangled wires and potential poor contact.Our 200ft extra-long string light can wrap around an entire tree,cover an entire patio,or even illuminate a medium-sized garden with one string lights,no splicing needed,Installation is time-saving,making the decor looking seamless and attractive.

items.label: Shatterproof + Spare
items.value: The kit includes 60 pcs S11 shatterproof bulbs.The bulb shells are made of hard shatter-proof plastic and are not easily damaged by impact.Additionally,it comes with 2 spare bulbs,accidental damage can be replaced in time,no additional purchase required.The S11 large bulb design offers a wider illumination range,2700K warm light is soft and not dazzling.When lit up in the evening,it instantly fills the air with a sense of warmth,creating a full atmosphere for both daily gatherings and festival celebrations.

items.label: Waterproof
items.value: Professional waterproof technology ensures no short circuit in rainy days,can withstand harsh weather conditions, and can be used with confidence in rainy,foggy and humid environments.Decorate your garden in spring and light up your porch in winter-hung all year round,no need to disassemble,durable and more reliable in lighting.

items: Suitable for multi-scenario outdoor needs,easily create a unique atmosphere—fence winding,tree decoration, party,wedding venue arrangement etc. Simple installation,instantly transform your courtyard and terrace into an exquisite outdoor space,applicable to various outdoor scenarios.

items.label: After-sales service
items.value: All products undergo strict testing to ensure quality and safety. We offer a 365-day warranty,If any problems occur during this period,please contact us directly and we will replace or offer assistance for free.Buy with confidence and use with peace of mind.
